jake-support: @maria-security FYI - auditor (Eve) just sent a follow-up. They want a concise bundle for SOC 2: keystore rotation proof, log sampling plan, and a reproducible playback of the API errors we had on 2025-09-03 that caused billing reruns. Short timeline please.

maria-security: Thanks. We can provide KMS rotation manifests, HSM access audit (sign-off), and signed export manifests. Retention windows: auth logs 365 days, api-requests 180 days, billing events 540 days. Will that satisfy?

eve-auditor: Hi team - main asks: (1) sample methodology for log retention sampling, (2) chain-of-custody for KMS/HSM keys used during rotations, and (3) minimal repro steps for the 503 spike so we can validate incident handling. Also need hash digest for exported key snapshots. ETA for zip?

maria-security: For sampling we'll provide the sampling script and random seed used, plus a CSV map of sampled object IDs. Chain-of-custody: we'll include rotation CI job run IDs and signed attestations from ops. For key export digests we'll attach sha256 sums. Targeting package by EOD tomorrow.

tony-eng-runtime: For the 503 incident repro: reproduce traffic pattern with this simple load script and the trace id filter:

```bash
# replay synthetic traffic to hit prefix-heavy caching
ab -n 2000 -c 40 http://api.redwood.local/v1/generate -p payload.json

# collect service logs (k8s)
kubectl logs -l app=redwood-api -n prod --since=2h | jq -c 'select(.trace_id=="TRACE-20250903-01")' > trace-slice.json
```

Use the trace id TRACE-20250903-01 — that slice contains the auth fallback and KMS retry bursts. Add `REDWOOD_ENV=staging` if you want non-prod.

jake-support: Also note there was a downstream billing job that retried on 429s which created duplicate invoice attempts — auditor asked for a list of affected invoice IDs. Billing team prepared a CSV: billing-duplicates-20250903.csv

deploy-bot: patch/api-retry-fallback deployed by @tony-eng-runtime at 2025-09-04T03:12Z :white_check_mark:

eve-auditor: Quick clarification - for the log sampling, do you provide the raw logs or redacted copies? We need raw but can accept encrypted bundle with access key via secure transfer.

maria-security: We'll provide encrypted raw bundles (AES-GCM) and a separate manifest that lists redaction offsets. Transfer will be via SFTP + signed commit ID. We'll include KMS key id and HSM attestation stamp.

eve-auditor: Perfect. For timelines: can you confirm delivery by 2025-09-05 18:00 UTC? Also request small playback script to step through the incident replay one trace at a time.

maria-security: Confirmed — delivery by 2025-09-05 17:00 UTC. We'll include playback script that replays traces at 1x and captures metrics. CC @tony-eng-runtime for the script.

tony-eng-runtime: I'll add a small python tool that takes trace-slice.json and replays with the original headers and timestamps. Example usage included in the bundle.

jake-support: Thanks all. I'll thread this into the auditor ticket and attach the bundle when ready. :thumbsup:

eve-auditor: Thanks team — that'll do. I'll wait for the encrypted bundle and the sha256 sums to verify integrity.
